literal: Like strangers, looking an indifferent look, exists only in the eyes of lovers.
translation: Looking with an indifferent glance as if they were strangers is a behavior that exists only in the eyes of lovers.
modern: அந்நியர்களைப் போலப் பொதுவான பார்வையாகப் பார்ப்பது, காதலர்களுடைய கண்களிலேயே இருக்கிறது.
explanation: This couplet describes the secret language of lovers when they are in public. To hide their mutual affection from onlookers, they look at each other with a cold, casual, or indifferent glance, mimicking how strangers behave. The poet points out that this feigned indifference is actually a sign of deep intimacy. Such a deceptive yet meaningful gaze is a unique art found only in the eyes of those who love.
